items.text: Whitney Houston's "I Will Always Love You" was the longest-running number-one single of 1992 on the Billboard Hot 100, staying at the top of the chart for 14 weeks.
items.question: Where were you when you first heard Whitney Houston sing "I Will Always Love You", and who were you with?
items.source_quote: This is a list of the U.S. Billboard magazine Hot 100 number-ones of 1992. The longest running number-one single of 1992 is "I Will Always Love You" by Whitney Houston, which stayed at the top of the chart for 14 weeks.

items.text: In 1992, compact discs outsold audiocassettes in the United States for the first time, in terms of units sold.
items.question: Do you remember the first compact disc you bought, and what did you play it on?
items.source_quote: In terms of units sold, compact discs outsell audiocassettes for the first time in the United States.

items.text: The Mall of America, the largest shopping mall in the U.S., opened in Bloomington, Minnesota, on August 11, 1992.
items.question: Did you ever visit the Mall of America, and who did you go with?
items.source_quote: August 11 – The largest shopping mall in the U.S., Minnesota's Mall of America, constructed on 78 acres (316,000 m2), opens in Bloomington.
